stories.title: The harbor council approves a tide barrier
stories.dek: After a year of hearings, the council voted seven to two to fund a movable barrier across the harbor mouth.

stories.title: A regional grid adds its largest battery yet
stories.dek: The new installation can hold enough power for a small city through an evening peak.

stories.title: City libraries extend their evening hours
stories.dek: Branches in six neighbourhoods will stay open until ten on weekdays.

stories.title: The river festival returns with a quieter schedule
stories.dek: Organisers cut the fireworks and added a morning of boat tours.
